critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_otp: `attempts` increment happens then compared against stale `rec.attempts`. Behaviourally correct (429 kicks in on the 6th wrong attempt) but slightly non-obvious — a short code comment would help.

admin_orders.purge deletes ALL otp_requests globally. Under parallel test runners (xdist enabled by default in /app/backend/pytest.ini via `-n auto --dist loadscope`) this cross-worker races with concurrent OTP flow tests. Ran serially (-n 0) for the iteration file. Consider scoping purge to admin-side data only, or add a test-only flag.
